title: Spanakorizo
subtitle: Greek spinach and rice in olive oil and lemon
excerpt: Spinach and rice cooked together in olive oil with spring onions and dill, finished with lemon. A Greek ladera dish that is hearty enough to eat as a main with feta crumbled on top.
sourceNotes: Greek ladera tradition, widely cooked across Greece. Eaten year-round as a main or side dish.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Can be made a few hours ahead. Reheat on the hob with a splash of water. Serve with extra lemon.

content.text: Spanakorizo is spinach and rice cooked in one pan with plenty of olive oil. The spinach wilts into the rice and flavours the whole dish. The lemon goes in at the end; do not add it too early or it turns bitter.
Warm the olive oil in the large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the spring onions and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the rinsed rice and coat in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the spinach in large handfuls. Stir as it wilts down, adding more until all the spinach is in the pan.
Pour in the hot stock. Season with salt and pepper. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on a low heat for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from the heat. Stir in the lemon juice and dill. Replace the lid and rest for 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve warm with extra lemon wedges and feta if you like.

items.cause: Too much liquid or the heat was too high.
items.fix: Spread the rice in the pan and leave the lid off for a few minutes to let steam escape.

items.cause: The lemon was added too early and cooked with the rice.
items.fix: Add lemon only off the heat at the end. Use a little less next time and add to taste.

items.symptom: The rice has caught on the bottom.
items.cause: The heat was too high and the liquid ran out before the rice finished cooking.
items.fix: Add a splash of water and reduce the heat immediately. A little colour on the base is not a problem.
